The helicity of a localized solenoidal vector field (i.e. the integrated scalar product of
the field and its vector potential) is known to be a conserved quantity under ‘frozen
field’ distortion of the ambient medium. In this paper we present a number of results
concerning the helicity of linked and knotted flux tubes, particularly as regards
